files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Create one production character sprite for a fantasy exploration adventure game. Rescue coordinator Sena stands alone in a relaxed three-quarter front view, full body from hair to boot soles, centered with generous transparent margins. Short auburn hair swept back, attentive dark eyes, a focused composed expression, a muted brick-red practical work coat over a charcoal vest and linen shirt, a plain leather belt, dark trousers and sturdy walking boots. Both hands are empty; one opens at waist level in a restrained directing gesture and the other rests naturally at the side. Hand-painted illustration with restrained textured brushwork, natural body proportions, clear facial features, softly modeled fabric and leather, soft even light, a crisp readable silhouette. The figure and clothing alone form the visible image, with clean transparent space immediately around the silhouette. The entire surrounding canvas is genuinely transparent. Portrait canvas 1024 by 1536.
files.prompt_ja: 用途は物語イラスト。幻想的な探索ゲーム用の人物立ち絵。救助責任者セナが一人、少し斜め正面を向いて自然に立つ。髪から靴底までの全身を中央に置き、透明の余白を十分に取る。後ろへ流した短い赤茶の髪、注意深い暗色の瞳、集中した落ち着いた表情。麻のシャツと濃灰色の胴着に落ち着いた煉瓦色の実用的な作業上着、革のベルト、暗いズボン、丈夫な歩行靴。両手は空で、片手を腰の高さで控えめに指示するように開き、もう一方を自然に下ろす。抑制の利いた筆の質感を持つ手描きのイラスト、自然な体の比率、明瞭な顔、柔らかな布と革の立体、均一で柔らかな光、明瞭な輪郭。人物と服だけが見え、輪郭のすぐ周囲から透明の空間。背景全体が完全に透明。縦長1024×1536。
